summary: Frontend-only test on mobile viewport 390x844 against https://wake-up-challenge-5.preview.emergentagent.com. BLOCKER FOUND AND FIXED by testing agent: `/app/frontend/src/onboarding/steps.ts` referenced `SET_ALARM` (line ~161) which was never imported/defined, causing `ReferenceError: SET_ALARM is not defined` at module load — the splash/welcome/every route crashed with a red 'Uncaught Error' overlay. Per the spec ('Onboarding no longer contains a time-picker step. Last info slide before commitment is now the gratitude/thank-you slide.') the entire 'Set the time' info step is supposed to be gone (the time picker now lives at /set-alarm). I removed that orphan step, restarted Expo, and re-ran. After the fix, every requested scenario PASSES end-to-end with 0 console errors. Full happy path verified: splash → welcome (cream BG, 'Welcome!' eyebrow above bird, 'charrpy' lowercase orange, 'Wake up. Win mornings.' subtitle) → onboarding (exactly 13 steps, no time picker; ends on gratitude → commitment) → avatar-select (19 tiles in 3-col grid, NEW illustrated person avatars on light-blue backgrounds, not chicks) → nickname (typed `test_user_42`) → Firebase signInAnonymously SUCCEEDS (anon auth is now enabled on charrpy-2026) → /ringtone-select (title 'Pick a ringtone', 'Tap to preview.', 5 rows: Classic Alarm / Bell Chime / Gentle Morning / Pop Alarm / Wake-up Melody with vibe captions, play/volume-high icon on right, CONTINUE disabled until a row is tapped, orange ring + filled radio appear on tap, volume-high icon swaps in on selected row) → tapping CONTINUE persists `charrpy.ringtone.id="gentle"` to AsyncStorage/localStorage and routes to /set-alarm → set-alarm (orange alarm badge, 'Set your alarm', 'This is tomorrow\'s win.', 3-wheel time picker hours/minutes/AM-PM with default 7:00 AM, live 'Wake up at 7:00 AM' preview pill, LOCK IT IN orange 3D button) → LOCK IT IN persists `charrpy.alarm.time="7:00 AM"` and routes to /paywall → tapping 'Maybe later' routes to /(main) → main shows the selected new-set avatar, greets 'hey test_user_42 👋', shows truncated ANON UID pill, and RESET & START OVER clears storage + signs out + returns to /welcome. No console errors. The two non-blocking RN warnings from iteration_2 (pointerEvents deprecation, setState-during-render) did NOT fire in this run — they were tied to the time-picker step inside Onboarding which has now been removed; TimePickerInline is still used on /set-alarm but did not throw during this run. expo-audio version mismatch warning is present in expo logs (installed 56.0.11 vs Expo's expected ~1.1.1) but audio playback path executed without throwing in the web preview.

critical_code_review_comments: src/onboarding/steps.ts had a fatal, easily-caught bug: a `require(...)` for SET_ALARM was deleted but the consuming step entry was left behind, leaving `art: SET_ALARM` as a free variable reference. Recommend a lightweight TypeScript strictness pass or a unit test that just imports `ONBOARDING_STEPS` to catch this class of regression — it would have failed at module load.

ringtone-select.tsx is clean: AudioPlayer is torn down on unmount AND before starting a new preview, Haptics.selectionAsync errors are swallowed, CONTINUE correctly gates on `selected !== null`, and the row uses 3D-bordered Pressable with proper press-state offset.

set-alarm.tsx persists `charrpy.alarm.time` in a human-readable 'H:MM AM/PM' format — fine for now since downstream is still a stub, but note that downstream alarm scheduling will need a structured representation (hour/minute/meridiem) — consider also writing the structured TimeValue to a second key for forward-compat.
Files reviewed are all under ~270 lines (well within the 700-line threshold); StyleSheet usage and SafeAreaView edges are consistent across the new screens.
All new interactive elements have stable testIDs (ringtone-row-<id>, ringtone-select-continue-button, ringtone-select-back-button, set-alarm-screen, set-alarm-continue-button, set-alarm-back-button).

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/frontend/src/onboarding/steps.ts a previous iteration removed the `const SET_ALARM = require('../../assets/images/onboarding/set-alarm.png');` import (because the time picker became a dedicated /set-alarm route) but left the consuming step entry behind, with `art: SET_ALARM` still referenced. At module evaluation the bundler resolved `SET_ALARM` as a free identifier and threw `ReferenceError: SET_ALARM is not defined`, which propagated up to ContextNavigator and rendered the red error overlay on every route. REPRODUCTION (pre-fix): open the preview URL → red 'Uncaught Error / SET_ALARM is not defined' overlay regardless of route. MITIGATION: removed the orphan info step entry; restarted Expo to flush the Metro bundle cache. Full happy-path now completes with 0 console errors.
